title: What supporting systems are still needed before commissioning a 20-metre variable-volume gas-fired furnace?
summary: Suneng's completion proposal for a 20-metre variable-volume gas-fired furnace lists the rear-wall sealing mechanism as already installed on site, but explicitly states that its sealing pipework is still missing. It also schedules lining installation, mechanical completion and electrical-control work. Readiness for commissioning depends on the connections between actuators, sealing sequence, position signals and controls, not merely the presence of mechanisms.
